title: EC4MC HD
description: This resorce pack makes EC4MC's Element Cattos to be from the EC wiki rather than EC (Game)!
body:
This is a resource pack of EC4MC, the link to the main mod is over here : https://modrinth.com/mod/ec4mc

Before we start: ***The game was made by Lily "Oberorka" Irie! I'm NOT the real creator of Element Cattos and this is a fan-made project!***

**Hi! If you like Element Cattos I recommend checking the real EC over here!: https://oberorka.itch.io/elementcattos**

**Short Description:**
This resource pack makes Element Cattos' paintings into their Wiki images for EC4MC. For vanilla item textures are changed to cattos.

(For Vanilla) changed items list: 
- Coal (as Carbon)
- Iron ingot and raw Iron (as Iron)
- Gold ingot and raw Gold (as Gold)
- Copper ingot and raw Copper (as Copper)
- Lava Bucket (as red-hot Iron behind the glass of the bucket)
- Milk Bucket (as Calcium behind the glass of the bucket)
  

**Future of this txt:**
Uhh.. monthly updates of old sprites, and random for EC4MC?
